feeds.title: Arquibancada Tricolor
feeds.description: The Arquibancada Tricolor began its activities in June 2008 and today is one of the main channels for São Paulo FC fans on the internet. Our content is produced by our team on a daily basis, we cover news, games, events and everything related to the club's day-to-day, in all modalities.

feeds.title: Bolavip Brazil » São Paulo
feeds.description: Bolavip Brazil is a website dedicated to Brazilian and world football. For people who want first-hand news, Bolavip Brazil is the right place. Read São Paulo blogs on the site to get the latest news from São Paulo and about the players.

feeds.title: Tricolor Nation
feeds.description: Here at nacaotricolor.com , you will find all the news from São Paulo. Find Hot information about everything that goes on at the biggest club in São Paulo: games, results, transfers, backstage and everything about São Paulo.

feeds.title: São Paulo Sempre
feeds.description: Publicist and journalist Daniel Perrone is one of the biggest references among São Paulo FC fans. He currently manages Blog São Paulo Semper where he gives the latest updates about São Paulo and happening in the industry. He also writes about history and you can find some of his review articles as well on the website.

feeds.title: SPFC Noticias
feeds.description: The idea of the site is to bring information, entertainment and fun to São Paulo, We post news about the São Paulo tricolor, both from the professional team, as well as from the youth categories, women's football and basketball, making polls, rankings, memes, posts about important dates, birthdays of players and former tricolor players and of course, real-time coverage of ALL SPFC matches and posts about the history of our São Paulo Futebol Clube.

feeds.title: São Paulo Blog
feeds.description: São Paulo Blog is a dedicated news site about São Paulo Futebol Clube, reviews about games, the player market, and about the championships disputed by the team, and many more written by the writer Alexandre Zanquetta.

feeds.title: Gazeta Esportiva » São Paulo
feeds.description: GazetaEsportiva.com is a Brazilian sports news portal based in São Paulo. Gazeta Esportiva acts as a news agency supplying other media with photos and the latest information on sports. Explore the blog and get to know about the latest news and results of the games about São Paulo on the website that is updated regularly for you
